    Player Bio - Michael Olise

    Michael Olise is a professional footballer from France. He is a 184cm | 6'0" tall, left-footed midfielder (RM) who plays for FC Bayern München in Bundesliga. He was born on 12-12-2001 and he is now 24 years old.

    His real-life stats are currently 4 goals and 1 assists in 4 matches in domestic competition. He also received 0 yellow card(s) and 0 red card(s).

    FC 27 Team of the Week - Michael Olise

    Michael Olise's Team of the Week card is rated 91. He has a 3-star weak foot and 5-star skill moves, giving him the ability to perform every skill move in the game. He does not have a real face in-game. He has been used in 3,620 games with a GPG (goals per game) of 0.736. He has been used in 535 games with a GPG (goals per game) of 0.802. The best chemistry style for him is Hunter. The best chemistry style for him is Hunter. Michael Olise has 2 special cards with ratings between 90 and 91.

    His current price on FUT is 1,080,000 on PlayStation, 1,080,000 on Xbox, and 1,380,000 on PC.
